name: s3Read
syntax: s3Read(bucket, object [, charset, accessKeyId, secretKey, host])
description: Reads an object from an S3 (or S3-compatible) bucket and returns its body as a UTF-8 string.

params.name: bucket
params.description: The name of the S3 bucket to read from.

params.name: charset
params.description: Character encoding to use when decoding the body (informational; bodies are decoded as UTF-8).

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: Inline AWS access key id. Overrides credentials from Application.cfc and environment variables.

params.name: host
params.description: Inline endpoint URL for S3-compatible providers (e.g. Cloudflare R2, MinIO).

examples.title: Read an object into a string
examples.description: Reads the body of an object from a bucket.
